

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Callsign/hometown: the archived decipher.com listing (cited on the Service row) gives Gold 36, Bettendorf, IA; the fan Squadron Members table gives Gold 36, Cedar Falls, Ia. The article uses the Decipher listing. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 11:39, 14 October 2026 (UTC)
== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 3 November 2016. The Facebook photo viewer names David Detlefs. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 36 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Cedar Falls, Ia; the person article also cites Bettendorf, IA). The Facebook profile lists Lives in Kirkland, Washington and From Westfield, New Jersey, a later residence than the 1990s Iowa roster town. A comment on the photograph names Hacker Square at Facebook Menlo Park.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:David Detlefs portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:David Detlefs Facebook portrait.jpg]].
